personalTools.title: Personal tools
personalTools.description: Connect your tools privately within this Workspace. Choose access separately for each connection.
personalTools.empty: No personal connections yet. Connect a tool to use it in your personal Sessions.
personalTools.operationError: The operation could not be confirmed. Reload to inspect the current state before retrying.
personalTools.disconnectExplanation: Disconnect this personal Toolkit for all allowed Agents in this Workspace. Future personal Sessions cannot use this connection until you reconnect it. This does not undo completed actions or guarantee revocation of credentials already exported to a Runtime.
personalTools.deleteExplanation: Delete {name} and stop future use by your Agents. This does not undo completed actions or promise to revoke credentials already exported to a Runtime.
personalTools.agentScope: Applies to all your personal Sessions with this Agent. Other users and Team Sessions do not use these connections.
personalTools.connectionScope: Choose which Agents in this Workspace may use this connection. Hidden selections are preserved.
personalTools.allExplanation: All Agents you can access in this Workspace, now or later, are allowed. Uncheck one to use Selected Agents.
personalTools.firstRestriction: Saving keeps the currently accessible Agents in this Workspace except those you restrict. Future Agents are not added automatically.
personalTools.noAgents: No accessible Agents. Allow all will include Agents when you gain access.
personalTools.noMatches: No matches. Hidden selections are preserved.
personalTools.saveError: The save could not be confirmed.
personalTools.conflict: Access changed since you opened this page.
personalTools.draftRetained: Your draft is preserved. Reload the current policy before retrying if the result is uncertain.
